definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a person who belongs to an organization or performs a role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}{員|いん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work as a company employee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}{員|いん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a station staff member tell me the way.

notes:
～⟦{員|いん}→〜員：01994_in⟧ is a suffix indicating a person who belongs to an organization or performs a specific role.

COMMON WORDS:
- ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧: company employee
- ⟦{銀行員|ぎんこういん}→銀行員：05058_ginkouin⟧: bank employee
- ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧: store clerk
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: member
- ⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧: station staff
- ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧: committee member
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: company employee
- ⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: staff member

USAGE:
Often combines with organization names or role descriptors. The kanji ⟦{員|いん}→〜員：01994_in⟧ means "member" or "personnel" and appears in many workplace-related terms.

SIMILAR SUFFIXES:
- ⟦～{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: person who does ~ (focuses on action)
- ～⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: expert/professional
- ～⟦{員|いん}→〜員：01994_in⟧: member/staff (focuses on belonging)
